title: SSC Junior Engineer (JE) Examination 2026
description: Staff Selection Commission open recruitment of Junior Engineers across CPWD, Military Engineer Services (MES), Central Water Commission (CWC), and Border Roads Organisation. Demands 3-Year Diploma in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering from a recognized board/institution.
selectionProcess: Tier-I (Computer Based Examination, 200 Marks) ➔ Tier-II (Descriptive Engineering Domain, 300 Marks) ➔ Document Verification.
syllabus: Paper-I: General Intelligence & Reasoning (50), General Awareness (50), Core Engineering (100). Paper-II: In-depth technical domain curriculum.
checklist: SSC (10th) Board Certificate for DOB verification
Valid Category Certificate (OBC-NCL / SC / ST / EWS)

title: NTPC Diploma Engineer Trainee (DET) 2026
description: NTPC Limited (India's largest power conglomerate, Maharatna PSU) recruiting Diploma Engineer Trainees across coal, gas, and hydro power stations. Requires regular 3-year diploma with min. 70% marks (Pass marks for SC/ST/PwD).
selectionProcess: Stage-I (Online Aptitude Test, 120 Marks) ➔ Stage-II (Technical Discipline Test, 120 Marks). Final merit strictly on Stage-II performance.
syllabus: Stage I: General English, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning. Stage II: Core Diploma Subject Matter (C&I, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil).
checklist: Full Marks Memo of 3-Year SBTET Diploma

title: TSGENCO Sub-Engineer (Electrical, Mechanical & Civil)
description: Telangana State Power Generation Corporation Limited recruiting Sub-Engineers for thermal (Kothagudem, Ramagundam) and hydel generation stations across Telangana.
selectionProcess: Written Examination (100 Marks: 80 Core Technical + 20 General Awareness & Telangana Statehood History) ➔ Certificate Verification.
syllabus: 80% Core SBTET Diploma C-21/C-24 curriculum + 20% Telangana History, Culture, and Logical Aptitude.
checklist: SBTET Diploma Certificate in DEEE / DCE / DME / DEIE
Telangana Local Candidate Study / Residence Certificate (Classes 4 to 10)
Non-Creamy Layer Certificate for BC candidates

title: ECIL Technical Officer & Scientific Assistant (Hyderabad Unit)
description: Electronics Corporation of India Limited (A Govt. of India Enterprise under Dept. of Atomic Energy, Hyderabad) hiring Diploma Technical Personnel for Defence, Avionics, and Nuclear Control divisions.
selectionProcess: Merit screening based on Diploma Aggregate Marks followed by Technical Interview / Practical Skill Test at ECIL Hyderabad.
syllabus: Electronic Devices & Circuits, Microcontrollers, Instrumentation Systems, Embedded C, Digital Communication.
checklist: SBTET Diploma Provisional Certificate & Consolidated Marks Memo

title: Singareni Collieries (SCCL) Mining Sirdar & Trainee Sub-Engineer
description: The Singareni Collieries Company Limited (Telangana's premier coal mining PSU) recruiting Diploma Engineers and Mining Sirdar trainees across Kothagudem, Bellampalli, and Ramagundam coalfields.
selectionProcess: OMR-Based Objective Written Test ➔ Practical Fitness Verification ➔ Certificate Verification.
syllabus: Mining Methods, Mine Ventilation, Coal Mining Regulations (CMR), Core Electrical/Mechanical maintenance.
checklist: Diploma in Mining Engineering / EEE / Mechanical
Gas Testing Certificate & First Aid Certificate (for Mining Sirdar)

title: POWERGRID Diploma Trainee (PGCIL Southern Region-I)
description: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (Maharatna PSU) recruiting Diploma Trainees for transmission line and substation management in Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and Karnataka.
selectionProcess: Computer Based Test (Part-I: 120 Professional Technical Questions; Part-II: 50 Supervisory Aptitude Questions).
syllabus: Power Systems, Transmission Lines, Switchgear & Protection, Electrical Machines, General Aptitude.
checklist: SBTET Diploma with minimum 70% marks for UR/OBC

title: Nuclear Fuel Complex (NFC Hyderabad) Scientific Assistant-B
description: Nuclear Fuel Complex (Dept. of Atomic Energy, Moula-Ali, Hyderabad) recruiting Diploma Scientific Assistants for fuel fabrication and quality assurance laboratories.
selectionProcess: Preliminary Written Examination (50 MCQs) ➔ Advanced Technical Domain Test (50 MCQs) ➔ Personal Interview.
syllabus: Chemical Processes, Thermodynamics, Metallurgy Principles, Nuclear Fuel Cycle, Industrial Instrumentation.

title: SAIL Operator-cum-Technician Trainee (OCTT) 2026
description: Steel Authority of India Limited (Maharatna PSU) hiring Diploma holders for integrated steel manufacturing plants across Bhilai, Bokaro, Rourkela, and Durgapur.
selectionProcess: Computer Based Test (100 Marks: 50 Domain + 50 Aptitude) ➔ Skill / Physical Trade Test (Pass/Fail).
syllabus: Physical Metallurgy, Iron & Steel Making, Machine Design, Industrial Automation, Electrical Drive Systems.
checklist: Diploma in Metallurgy / Mechanical / Electrical / Chemical

title: DRDO CEPTAM-11 Senior Technical Assistant-B & Tech-A
description: Centre for Personnel Talent Management under DRDO hiring technical personnel for research laboratories across India (including DRDL, RCI, and DMRL in Hyderabad).
selectionProcess: Tier-I (CBT screening test) ➔ Tier-II (Trade / Skill Test - qualifying nature).
syllabus: Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, Trade Section based on Core SBTET Curriculum.
checklist: SBTET Recognized 3-Year Diploma or ITI in relevant trade

title: TGPSC Assistant Engineer (AE - I&CAD, PR&RD, R&B)
description: Telangana Public Service Commission recruitment for Assistant Engineers across Irrigation & CAD and Roads & Buildings. Requires a recognized LCE/LME/LEE Diploma or equivalent.
selectionProcess: Computer-Based or OMR Written Examination ➔ Direct Document Verification.
syllabus: Paper-1: General Studies and General Abilities. Paper-2: Engineering Discipline (Diploma Level).
checklist: Diploma in Civil / Mechanical / Electrical Engineering
Telangana Zone Study Certificate (Local status proof)
EWS Certificate (Current financial year) if applicable
